data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is not substantive but caused by a tool error. The qwen model failed to complete its PKGBUILD audit due to an HTTP 400 BadRequestError from the LLM API, resulting in an inconclusive verdict. learnings: Tool errors (API failures, timeouts, crashes) should be clearly distinguished from substantive security findings in the final verdict. An inconclusive due to tool failure should not trigger escalation as if it were a genuine disagreement about safety.

When one model fails due to a tool error and another succeeds with a clean audit of the same files, the successful audit should be weighted heavily rather than treating the situation as a true disagreement requiring resolution.
For -bin packages with pinned checksums from official domains, models should explicitly note that the checksum pins the artifact and closes the swap risk, making this a low-risk packaging pattern.
